expected_issues.title: Runtime cast() references a name imported only under TYPE_CHECKING
expected_issues.description:
DBAPIModule is only imported under TYPE_CHECKING, but it is used as a runtime argument to cast(), so import_dbapi() raises NameError and the mysqlconnector dialect cannot connect.

typing.cast() evaluates its first argument at runtime. The name is defined only inside `if TYPE_CHECKING:`, so calling MySQLDialect_mysqlconnector.import_dbapi() fails with NameError: name 'DBAPIModule' is not defined, breaking every create_engine('mysql+mysqlconnector://...'). In a typing-only change the cast target must be a string ('DBAPIModule') or imported at runtime.

annotator_notes: Upstream change https://github.com/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/commit/51a7678db2f0fcb1552afa40333640bc7fbb6dac. Primary issue confirmed by the later upstream fix https://github.com/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/commit/7ff2e7070a4fb021de83eec0eb8ae05de02d6fbb; its regression test reproduces the problem on this head.
